name: Isobutyl methacrylate polymer
description: Poly(isobutyl methacrylate) (CAS 9011-15-8 ) is an acrylic polymer resin used across coatings, adhesives, and polymer formulation. It functions as a film-former and rheology modifier, contributing flexibility and adhesion to finished systems. In solvent-based coatings and lacquers, it builds durable, clear films with good gloss retention. This makes it a preferred binder for wood and metal finishing applications where clarity and durability are essential. Adhesive and sealant formulators incorporate it to balance tack, cohesion, and substrate wetting. It is particularly effective in pressure-sensitive and contact adhesive systems requiring specific performance profiles. As a plasticizing resin in rigid polymer blends, it reduces brittleness and improves processability. It is valued because it does not migrate out of the matrix over time, ensuring long-term stability. Industrial cleaning and maintenance products use it as a film-forming agent in protective coatings. It is also frequently utilized in strippable masking formulations for temporary surface protection. The material is typically supplied as beads, granules, or as a solution in organic solvent. The choice of format depends on the intended processing method and the specific requirements of the manufacturing line. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering for this polymer. Molecular weight and solution viscosity are the key specification parameters buyers should confirm with their chemical suppliers. Bulk and drum quantities are the common supply formats for industrial procurement.
